english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for unpleasant, tedious work or chores.
Use this for a difficult, tedious, or unpleasant undertaking.

examples.english: This job is real drudgery; I have to do the same thing every day.
examples.traditional: 呢份工真係苦差事，日日都要重複做同一樣嘢。
examples.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 fu2 caai1 si6 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 cung4 fuk1 zou6 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5

examples.english: Moving all these boxes is a tedious task.
examples.traditional: 搬晒呢堆箱真係苦差事。
examples.jyutping: bun1 saai3 ni1 deoi1 soeng1 zan1 hai6 fu2 caai1 si6
